1. (Currently amended) A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, __a cap member disposed at a second end of the columnar body opposite the first end__, and an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member.

2. (Cancelled)

3. (Previously presented) The lamp of claim 1 further including a light dispersing optic element overlapping said diodes.

4. (Previously presented) The lamp of claim 4 wherein said optic element includes a phosphor material.

5. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said diodes are substantially evenly spaced radially around the columnar body __and wherein the columnar body has a substantially circular cross-section__.

6. (Previously presented) The lamp of claim 5 wherein said fins are substantially equally disposed between said diodes.

7. (Cancelled)

8. (Cancelled)

9. (Cancelled)

10. (Previously presented) The lamp of claim 9 wherein a single diode resides on each face.

11. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body and said fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than __200__ W/mK.

12. (Previously presented) The lamp of claim 9 including a single optic element is disposed between each adjacent fin over-lapping said diode.

13. (Currently amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said base member comprises an Edison screw base or a wedge base __and wherein the lamp has a substantially spherical light distribution pattern__.

14. (Previously presented) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said electronics module comprises a printed circuit board including circuitry for converting AC to DC current.

15. (Previously presented) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element preferentially directs light substantially perpendicular to an elongated axis of the columnar body.

16. (Currently amended) A lamp comprising an elongated hollow __substantially circular__ body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than __200__ W/mK, a fin extending radially from __the circumference of__ said body, a light emitting diode mounted to __the circumference of__ said body, a screw or wedge base connector closing a first end of said body, __a cap member closing__ a second end of said body __opposite the first end__, an electronics module disposed within said body in electrical communication with said connector and said light emitting diodes, said lamp having a general A19 outline.

17. (Currently amended) A method of manufacturing a lamp comprising extruding an elongated hollow body __having a substantially circular cross-section__, said body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than __200__ W/mK, cutting said body to a predetermined length, attaching at least one light emitting diode to said body and providing electrical circuitry suitable for powering said light emitting diode.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said material has a thermal conductivity greater than about __250__ W/mK.

19. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said body includes a plurality of integral radially extending fins __and wherein the body has a substantially circular cross-section__.

20. (Currently amended) The method of claim __19__ wherein said body has substantially straight side walls.
